$description: C1XX Foundations · UI icon system. Brand-agnostic, so it sits in foundations and both themes share it. Glyphs are vendored from Lucide (ISC licence, see foundations/icons/LICENSE) and normalised: 24 grid, 20 live area, stroke 2, round caps and joins, currentColor. Themes add nothing here — colour comes from fg/action roles at the point of use; Syncline's dance pictograms are a separate, expressive tier in themes/syncline/pictograms.json.

grid.$description: Glyphs are drawn inside the 20 px live area; the 2 px padding keeps optical weight even at 16 px. Circular glyphs fill the 20 keyline, square ones the 18 keyline so they read the same size.

lg.$description: 24 · nav bars, empty states, icon buttons

sizes.$description: Three sizes only. Stroke stays 2 at every size (Lucide scales the whole glyph, so stroke is 1.33 at sm and 2 at lg visually — accepted; never set a different strokeWidth).

color.$description: Icons never carry their own colour. They inherit from the text they sit with (currentColor) or take exactly one of these roles.

touch.$description: An icon alone is never a target. Icon buttons are size.control-md 40 / control-lg 48; hit area never below size.touch-min 44 (extend with negative margin at md).

naming.$description: lucide name, kebab-case, verb-or-noun, no size or colour in the name. Direction is literal (chevron-left), state is a suffix (bell-off, eye-off, lock-open). Figma: Icon / Name=<name>. Code: <Icon name="..." size="md" /> or lucide-react's PascalCase export.

energy.$description: Movement, mood and intensity — the Syncline vocabulary, kept generic enough for the site
